title: Deinitialization and Resource Cleanup
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of deinitialization and resource cleanup in a Swift program or workflow.
Apply deinit in a small, inspectable example.

content.intro: This lesson focuses on deinitialization and resource cleanup and the practical choices around it. Start with the smallest example, connect it to “deinit”, and verify the result before adding complexity.
content.why_it_matters: Reusable functions and precise data models reduce duplication. Handling missing data and failures explicitly makes later application code safer to change.
